🧖 Upgrade Scenarios

Wellness Package + Game Room Positioning

This home isn't on the water — which means it wins on experience, not shoreline. At 2,576 square feet with 4 bedrooms sleeping 10, there's room to build the two amenity packages that move the needle most in the Brainerd Lakes Area: a wellness circuit and a dedicated game room. That combination directly attacks this market's biggest weakness — occupancy of just 21–29% from November through April — and turns an in-town Nisswa home steps from downtown into a true four-season destination.

♨️
Hot Tub
The single highest-ROI STR amenity in cold-weather markets — industry data consistently shows 15–20% higher annual revenue. Both amenity-led comps in this report have one. Est. investment: $8–15K.
🧖
Sauna
A barrel sauna makes a Minnesota winter a selling point instead of a liability and supports a premium ADR tier year-round. Est. investment: $6–12K.
🧊
Cold Plunge
Completes the hot/cold contrast circuit that defines the wellness-retreat category — a standout differentiator for a non-lakefront listing. Est. investment: $5–8K.
🎮
Game Room
Arcade, ping-pong, shuffleboard, or golf sim in the home's flex space. Converts rainy days and winter weekends for 10-guest family groups — and photographs like a magnet in search results. Est. investment: $8–20K.
📊 In-market evidence
Amenity-led positioning already wins in Nisswa. Comp #2 in this report — a 4-bedroom indoor-sports-court cabin with a hot tub — earns $119,702/yr at 51% occupancy, roughly triple this report's base case, on the strength of its entertainment and wellness amenities. Comp #4, a smaller 3-bedroom with a hot tub, sauna, and tennis court, holds a 36% occupancy floor despite sleeping only 7. This subject has more bedrooms, more square footage, and a walk-to-downtown Nisswa location — pairing that base with a full wellness package and game room puts it in the same experience-first category that the market's top earner occupies.

Investment & payback: Wellness package estimated at $19–35K; game room at $8–20K — $27–55K combined. At the base-case uplift of ~$13,500/yr in gross revenue, the midpoint investment pays back in roughly 3 years — before factoring the higher ADR floor, stronger winter bookability, and review/ranking momentum that compound over time. Uplift assumptions: wellness adds +10–15% ADR and +5–8 points of occupancy; the game room adds +5–8% ADR and +3–5 points, weighted toward the Nov–Apr window. Notably, the third-party market model already reads this property at $74,962/yr as-is — suggesting the upgrade-adjusted projections are well within reach once the amenity story is in place. 📋 Methodology

Analysis Assumptions & Methodology

🎯 Comp Selection Criteria
  • • Premium 3-5 bedroom properties in Nisswa
  • • Sleeps 7-12 guests (aligned with subject capacity)
  • • Active AirROI performance data (12-month trailing)
  • • Luxury tier finishes and amenities
  • • Strong review ratings (4.9+ stars)
📊 Data Sources
  • • AirROI: Property-level STR revenue, ADR, and occupancy
  • • Airbtics: Market-level overlay where coverage exists
  • • Airbnb: Live listing data and guest reviews
  • • Market Research: Nisswa tourism trends
  • • Comp Analysis: 6-category scoring engine (physical, financial, quality, amenity, reliability, must-match)
⚠️ Key Assumptions
  • • Adjustable available nights per year (100-365)
  • • Professional property management
  • • Premium photography and listing optimization
  • • Competitive dynamic pricing strategy
  • • Consistent 5-star guest experience delivery
💡 Performance Drivers
  • • Peak Season: Highest demand period for Nisswa
  • • Shoulder Season: Lower-demand months with optimization potential
  • • Amenity Premium: Standout features that drive higher ADR
  • • Location Premium: Proximity to attractions and points of interest
⚖️ Important Disclaimer
This analysis provides estimated gross revenue projections based on comparable property performance and market data. Actual results will vary based on operational execution, market conditions, seasonality, and property-specific factors. Revenue estimates are before all operating expenses including cleaning fees, platform commissions, utilities, property taxes, HOA/strata fees, maintenance, supplies, insurance, and management fees. Net operating income will be substantially lower after accounting for these costs. This report is for informational purposes only and should not be considered financial or investment advice.
